components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clear next action in a study flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; color: #07131a; background: #72e4c6; font: 750 14px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a7f5df; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72e4c6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low emphasis action that keeps the primary signal rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(213, 232, 227, .14); border-radius: 9px; color: #a9b8bf; background: transparent; font: 750 14px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #edf4f1; border-color: rgba(114, 228, 198, .52); background: rgba(114, 228, 198, .08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72e4c6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Study Input
components.description: A quiet field for words, plans, and study settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #a9b8bf; font: 700 13px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(213, 232, 227, .14); border-radius: 9px; color: #edf4f1; background: rgba(6, 13, 25, .66); font: 400 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #72e4c6; outline: 3px solid rgba(114, 228, 198, .1); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Study Panel
components.description: A tonal container for one coherent study task or result.
components.html:
今日清单

先完成这一项，再决定下一步。
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(213, 232, 227, .13); border-radius: 16px; color: #edf4f1; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(18, 31, 50, .93), rgba(13, 23, 39, .93)); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(2, 7, 16, .22); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 750 16px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #a9b8bf; font: 400 14px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: A compact route bar that keeps high value study destinations visible.
components.html: SEKAI今日清单开始背词
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(213, 232, 227, .13); color: #a9b8bf; background: rgba(8, 14, 25, .86); font: 700 13px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; color: #edf4f1; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-nav a, .ds-nav button { padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: inherit; background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav button:hover { color: #edf4f1; background: rgba(114, 228, 198, .07); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: #72e4c6; background: rgba(114, 228, 198, .1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72e4c6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: A compact visual record of study completion.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 5px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(213, 232, 227, .12); } .ds-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #72e4c6; }

narrative.overview:
SEKAI is a Chinese first English vocabulary workspace for the moment between intention and action. The visual language treats each screen like a quiet study ledger: midnight ink surfaces hold the content, paper like dividers separate decisions, and a single mint signal marks the next useful move.

The system is calm, precise, and slightly editorial. It keeps the existing study atmosphere while removing the old cyber grid, scan lines, and multi color neon treatment. The generated study desk image is used as a restrained anchor for hero surfaces and the practice card, so the product story stays tied to vocabulary study rather than generic productivity imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ink base with cool paper text
One mint signal accent for action, progress, and focus
Editorial image crop with negative space for copy
Compact navigation and task first page layouts
Motion that supports route orientation and yields to reduced motion preferences

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint is a signal, not wallpaper. Keep it concentrated on primary actions, active navigation, progress, focus rings, and meaningful study status.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: A screen should read clearly in grayscale before mint is added. Mint carries meaning only when it remains scarce.

rules.name: The Sentence First Rule
rules.body: Use a meaningful Chinese statement for page orientation before adding a category label. Labels support hierarchy but do not carry the story alone.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are quiet at rest. Hover changes border, tone, or position slightly and never turns a study screen into a light show.

dos: Do keep one clear next action visible near the page title.
Do use mint for meaning: action, active state, progress, focus, or study status.
Do use the study artwork with a calm crop and a dark copy gradient.
Do preserve visible labels for Chinese learners, especially on forms and study controls.
Do let mobile layouts stack content and remove decorative image crops when space is tight.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for route entry and background drift.
donts: Don't reintroduce scan lines, cyber grids, purple neon, or multi accent glow.
Don't turn every section into a generic card grid with equal visual weight.
Don't use category eyebrows as the main page hierarchy.
Don't place long English copy where a concise Chinese instruction is clearer.
Don't animate width, height, margin, or padding for interaction feedback.
Don't use a decorative image that competes with the word, answer, or next study action.
